saw_lines: Egg buyers pick a carton on price and size each week, and think about eggs only when a recipe calls for them.
So the sale is won in the ad, where a buyer needs a reason to pick eggs today, not a nutrition fact.
Your 3 Google text ads were last shown on 2026-05-12, so the next move is three new ones that name a reason to crack an egg today.
ads_1: Recipe-led Google text ads for egg buyers, with a price angle tested against it
